tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (ba)༄༅/ /'jam dbyangs la ri bo rtse lngar bstod pa nor bu'i phreng ba bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/na mo mañju nā thā ya/rgyal ba kun gyi ye
(ba)༄༅/ /'jam dbyangs la ri bo rtse lngar bstod pa nor bu'i phreng ba bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/na mo mañju nā thā ya/rgyal ba kun gyi ye

tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// 'jam dbyangs la ri bo rtse lngar bstod pa nor bu'i phreng ba bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ na mo mañju nā thā ya/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes rgya mtshor 'khrungs// mkhyen pa'i 'od gsal dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhing*// lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa// bla ma rin chen zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// ye shes rang bzhin rin chen las grub pa'i// 'jam mgon lhun po'i ngang gis mdzes mod kyang*// bdag yid rab tu dad pas bstod pa'i tshig /nor bu'i phreng bas brgyan phyir bsdeb par bgyi// drang srong bla ma khyod kyis legs bsten pa'i// gnas mchog dam pa dge legs dpal gyis mtshan// yid 'ong sna tshogs bkod pas lhang nge ba// thog mar de yi rang bzhin bsngags par bgyi// ji ltar nam mkha' kun la khyab mod kyang*// sprin bar khang pa'i mthongs na snang ba dang*// nyi ma nam mkha'i lam la rab rgyu yang*// shar gyi ri rtser 'char bar snang ba bzhin// 'jam dbyangs chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa yi// zhing khams kun na bzhugs mod de lta na'ang*// thugs rje'i shugs dang gdul bya'i mos pa yis// yul dus so sor snang bar gyur pa lags// de slad khyod kyi dag pa'i smon lam dag /skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams las grub pa'i// lhun po'i rgyal po'i ri bo rtse lnga ni// rtsa ba gser gyi dbang chen lta bur brtan// rtse mo bkod legs yongs su bskor ba'i tshul// dbus kyi ri bo seng ge bsgyings pa bzhin// brag ri kun+da'i mdangs ltar rab tu dkar// shar ri'i rtse mo glang po'i gtsug 'dra ba// rtswa mchog kha dog nam mkha'i mdangs ltar sngo// lho yi ri bo rta mchog nyal ba bzhin// me tog gser mdog ldan pas rnam par bkram// nub ri rma bya gar byed lta bu'i tshul// sa gzhi pad+ma rā ga'i 'od chags 'bar// byang ri mkha' lding 'dab gshog brkyang 'dra ba// margad mdog mtshungs ljon pas yongs su gang*// de slad 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas// dkyil 'khor chen po pho brang lags par khums// de 'dra'i lhun po 'phang dang rgyar yangs pa// sna tshogs shing dang lcug ma'i nags tshal bkram// kha dog sna tshogs mdangs gsal me tog gi

/tshom bu bkod legs ji bzhin rnam par bkra// 'du ba'i nad sel 'dus pa mchog ldan pa'i// rtsa ba lo ma me tog 'bras bu sogs// sman gyi tshogs kyis ngos rnams yongs su gang*// brag gi ri bo rin chen brtsegs 'dra dang*// dbang po'i gzhu ltar snang ba'i 'od 'byin pa'i// nor bu rdo yi snying pos rnam par spras// kha dog dri ro nus pa phun tshogs pa'i// bza' dang bcas dang myang dang bldags pa dang*// ma rmos lo tog la sogs du ma dang*// mu tig chun po rnam par 'thor 'dra ba'i// gzegs ma gnam du 'phro ba'i rba 'khrugs pa'i// dri za'i bu mo'i dbyangs ltar snyan pa'i sgra// kun tu sgrogs byed 'bab chu sna tshogs dang*// dri med dngul gyi me long bkod 'dra ba'i// lteng ka rdzing bu mtsho phran bkod ma rnams// yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu yi gter// snying po rab rgyas ze'u 'bru'i phreng ldan zhing*// lo 'dab mdangs bkra las 'phros dri bsung gis// nye bar bsdus pa'i bung ba sgra 'byin pa'i// pad+mo'i 'byung gnas dam pas nye bar bsten// ngang pa dur pa khu byug la sogs pa// yid 'ong gzugs kyi dpal ldan na chung bzhin// dbyibs dang mdangs kyis sgeg chags las byung ba'i// glu dbyangs snyan pa kun tu sgrogs par byed// rlung dang dal bus g.yo ba'i sil snyan sgras// nye bar bskul bas ljon shing ku sha'i tshogs// kun tu bskyod pa'i gar stabs legs byed cing*// ri dwags tshogs rnams rtse zhing dga' bar rol// gcan gzan lus rgyas rab tu dregs pa'i tshogs// bslab pas bsdams pa ji bzhin dul bar gnas// gdung ba skyob pa'i chu 'dzin bla rer bres// dri bsung gis bsgos ser bu'i bsil yab ldan// mi min gyis mchod mtshan mo sgron ma 'bar// 'dod chags bral ba 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams dang*// sa bla'i lha dang grub pa rig 'dzin dang*// dka' thub mthar phyin dmod pa'i mtshon 'chang ba'i// lha dang mi yi drang srong tshogs rnams dang*// klu dang gnod sbyin ma mo 'byung po sogs// mthu stobs che ba che bar rab grags pa// rdzu 'phrul shugs 'chang bstan la mngon dga' bas// rtag par rgyun du bstan cing rim gror byed// klu yi bu rnams rang gi lus bstan nas// mi rnams kun dang rtse zhing rnam par rol// de lta'i legs tshogs du mas brgyan pa'i gnas// lhun po 'di ni lhar bcas 'jig rten gyi// bsti gnas dam pa dge legs kun 'byung ba'i// mchod rten chen po de la phyag 'tshal lo// phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas der rnam rol pa'i// 'jam mgon de ni rgyal ba ji snyed kyis// legs par bsags pa'i bsod nams ye shes tshogs// de snyed legs grub khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi rang bzhin thog ma med pa nas// shin tu rnam dag srid dang zhi ba'i bdag

/ming dang mtshan ma kun gyis ma spros pa// mnyam nyid 'jam pa'i ngang la phyag 'tshal lo// chos kyi sprin la gnas pa rgya mtsho'i sprin// chos kyis tshim mdzad chos rje bde chen gter// thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor nges pa nyid// 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// smon lam grub pa dmigs med thugs rje yis// gdul bya ji snyed de snyed rnam 'phrul zhing*// srid pa ji srid de srid mi 'gag pa// 'jam dpal rnam par rol la phyag 'tshal lo// sku med ma lags bems po ma lags shing*// mi gtsang rdzas las grub pa'i lus ma lags// dbang po'i gzhu ltar gsal bar ston mdzad pa// dri med sku 'chang khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// lhun po lta bur rab tu brjid pa'i sku// mtshan dang dpe byad rgyan gyis rnam par spras// nyi ma stong las lhag pa'i 'od 'gyed pa// dpag yas 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// ji ltar nor bu chu shes dwangs pa ni// sna tshogs tshan gyi rkyen gyis du mar snang*/ de bzhin bcom ldan gdul bya'i dbang gis na// rnam pa du mar ston la phyag 'tshal lo// nyid kyi mdangs dang zhal dang phyag dang zhabs// nyams dang cha lugs rgyan dang phyag mtshan gdan// mos pa tha dad 'gro ba kun 'dul zhing*// zab mo'i don mtshon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gdul bya'i khams dang mos pa ji snyed pa// de snyed mgon po khyod kyi gsung gi dbyangs// yan lag drug cus brgyan pa mtha' yas pa// dam chos sgrogs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag med ston pa seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pa// mu stegs ri dwags gom pa 'khyor zhing 'bros// bdud sde'i wa tshogs snying rab 'gems byed pa// rgol ba tshar gcad gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod gsung rig sngags sbyar bas zhi ba dang*// blo gros rgyas byed tshangs pa'i bu mo sogs// nye bar 'gugs byed drag po'i gsang sngags kyis// bgegs kun 'joms par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// nyon mongs zug rngu'i tshogs rnams legs byang zhing*// las kyi 'ching grol skye ba'i gzeb las thar// shes bya'i sgrib pa'i rab rib rnam dag pa// yang dag mthar son khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// shes bya'i gzugs brnyan ji bzhin sgrib med snang*// rten 'brel ma 'dres gzigs shing mnyam par dgongs// gzhan gyi don kun legs grub rtag par yang*// rtog pas mi bsgul thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// byams pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya chen yangs pa can// thugs rje chen pos sems can kun skyob cing*// 'phags mchog rnams kyi yul las rnam 'das pa// 'jam dpal ye shes thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// rang bzhin dri med 'khor ba'i chos kyi gos// thabs kyi bdud bcas lam gyi rtsis bsgyur bas// grol ba'i yon tan sna tshogs tshon bkra ba// gnas yongs gyur pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rang gzhan don gnyis rten dang brten pa dang*// thun mong ba dang phul du byung ba dang*// zab dang rgya che'i yon tan rin chen gyis// rab tu brgyan pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mi zad tshig gi gter brnyes rgyal bas kyang*// blo mchog khyod kyi yon tan rgya mtsho'i gtos// bskal pa bye bar brjod kyang rdzogs bral ba// yon tan mi zad gter la phyag 'tshal lo// ji ltar yid bzhin nor bu rtog med par// skyes bu'i ri ba yongs su rdzogs byed ltar// gsol ba btab na dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba// dbang gi rgyal po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mtha' yas gdul bya'i tshogs rnams re re la'ang*// bgrang yas rnam par 'phrul pas don mdzad cing*// 'khor ba'i 'khor lo ji srid phrin las kyi// 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal sras rgya mtshos bskor ba'i rgyal ba yis// yongs su bstan pa'i zhing khams rgya mtsho yang*// ba spu'i bu gar 'phel 'grib rnam spangs nas// snang bar mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sa yi rgya khyon zhabs kyi mthil gyis gnon// phyag gis nam mkha'i ngos kun yongs su khebs// 'od kyis nyi ma bye ba rmugs byed pa// rnam 'phrul mtha' yas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// bzhad pa'i dbyangs kyis sa gsum g.yo byed cing*// ha ha zhes byas rgya mtsho'i klong rnams skems// hūm̐ gis dus mtha'i me dpung 'jil byed pa// mdzad pa dpag yas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gaṅgā'i rdul snyed phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yis// bskal par mdzad pa phrin las rgya mtsho'i tshogs// de snyed skad cig gcig gis rdzogs mdzad pa// phrin las lhun grub khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gti mug gis non 'gro ba bskyab pa'i phyir// dbus kyi ri rtser me long ye shes bdag

/'khor lo'i rigs kyi bdag po'i skur ston pa// gzugs phung sbyong mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhe sdang gis gzir 'gro ba bskyab pa'i phyir// shar gyi ri rtser chos dbyings ye shes bdag /rdo rje'i rigs kyi bdag po'i skur ston pa// rnam shes sbyong mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// ser snas bcings pa'i 'gro ba bskyab pa'i phyir// lho yi ri rtser mnyam nyid ye shes bdag /rin chen rigs kyi bdag po'i skur ston pa// tshor ba sbyong mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dod chags kyis gzer 'gro ba bskyab pa'i phyir// nub kyi ri rtser kun rtog ye shes bdag /pad+ma'i rigs kyi bdag po'i skur ston pa// 'du shes sbyong mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// phrag dog gis non 'gro ba bskyab pa'i phyir// byang gi ri rtser bya grub ye shes bdag /las kyi rigs kyi bdag po'i skur ston pa// 'du byed sbyong mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po phal cher gdul bya dag pa la// seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs pa byu ru'i mdangs// yid bzhin shing rnams sna tshogs 'khor rnams kyis// yongs su bskor ba ston la phyag 'tshal lo// la la la ni byis pa gzhon nu'i gzugs// rnam par rtse ba'i tshul gyis ston mdzad cing*// la lar dge sbyong drang srong rgan po sogs// sna tshogs skur ston khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod kyi ngo mtshar dpag yas rgya mtsho las// thigs pa tsam zhig brjod 'di rgyal ba yi// lung dang rtogs pa brjod pa'i rjes 'brangs nas// rigs pa yis kyang dpyad de bsgrags pa las// sngon chad mig gi dbang pos ma mthong zhing*// ji bzhin rna bas kyang ni ma thos pa'i// khyod kyi 'od zer shin tu phul byung ba// bdag gis mthong de mthong ba ji bzhin du// brjod par nus min ting 'dzin ro myang bzhin// 'on kyang dran pa yis kyang dpal 'gyur bas// cha tsam tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis ni// nye bar sgrogs la mngon par spro bar gyur// khyod kyi 'od kyis zhing brgya snang byed cing*// log blo'i ku mud tshal 'joms rtag par yang*// blo gros pad+mo rab tu rgyas byed pa// ye shes nyi ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod kyi 'od zer skye dgu'i yid 'phrog pa'i// thad na nyi ma'i 'od zer 'bar ba yang*// nyin mo'i zla ba tsam du'ang mi bzod na// mdzes pa gzhan kun zil gnon smos ci 'tshal// 'od zer de yis nyon mongs gdung sel ba// bsil zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dra 'phro ba yis// ston zla rgyas pas dper yang mi bzod na// log dad rab rib 'phrog pa smos ci 'tshal// de yis gdul bya'i zhing la dge legs kyi// lo tog rab tu bskrun pas rnam kun tu// char sprin rab tu sgrogs pa'ang zil gnon na// dad pa'i chu klung 'phel bgyid smos ci 'tshal// mkha' dang sa dang bar snang thams cad du// gnas ma nges par 'od zer kun tu snang*// kha dog sna tshogs mdangs chags rab tu gsal// dbyibs ni rnam pa du mar ston par byed// na bun 'od zer phung por gyur pa 'ga'// rlung gis bskyod pa'i rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs bzhin// zad mi shes pa bar snang mtshams na rgyu// 'od zer la la spel legs me tog gi

/phreng ba ji bzhin phan tshun brkyang ba dang*// la la nor bu spungs pa lta bu dang*// zla tshes 'dra dang tshes brgyad zla ba'i dbyibs// ka ba'i rnam pa lta bur snang ba dang*// 'od zer chen po 'ga' zhig nam mkha' dang*// sa gzhi bar kun khyab par snang bas na// de mtha' tshad gzung bdag gi rngo ma thogs// margad pad+ma rā ga lta bu'i mdangs// 'dres pa'i 'od kyi gong bu rab zlum pa// sprin med nam mkha'i dkyil na snang ba ni// khyod kyi mdzod spu'i 'od ces rgyal rnams sgrogs// sa gzhi'i gtos kun rab dkar 'od kyis ni// snyoms par khebs pa 'o ma'i rgya mtsho bzhin// bar snang gser mdog 'od kyis gang ba dang*// res 'ga' pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs 'drar 'gyur// na bun nang na kha dog lngas bskor ba'i// 'od 'khor 'khor lo lta bur snang ba ni// chu skyes chu gter dbus na rgyas pa bzhin// de mtha' rgyang nas 'od zer dkar pos bskor// de yi dbus na gzugs brnyan tshul gyis ni// nyid sku dang ldan dag gis gsal bar dmigs// grangs ni nyi ma gcig la'ang brgya phrag snyed// bdag cag rnams kyis legs mthong res 'ga' ni// snang dang mi snang gnas skabs du mar snang*// 'od kyi ser bu de 'dra gdul bya'i yid// bag chags chu gter 'dus pas brtan pa yang*// rab tu bskyod pas bsngags pa'i sgra sgrogs shing*// spyi bos 'dud pa'i rba rlabs g.yo bar 'gyur// de ltar rgyal dang rgyal sras thams cad kyi// 'od kyi mdzad pas zhing kun sbyong ba dang*// sems can smin par mdzad ces legs gsungs pas// 'jam dbyangs 'od la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// skya rengs 'od kyis skar ma zil gnon pa// gang gis mthong des nyi ma'i gzi brjid 'tshal// de bzhin 'od zer rmad byung mthong ba des// 'od mdzad yon tan dpag yas lags par khums// de ltar 'jam dbyangs yon tan rgya mtsho mchog /dam chos rin chen mi zad 'byung ba'i gnas// 'phags pa'i klu dbang tshogs kyis bsten pa la// srid pa kun tu nye bar skyabs su mchi// mgon po'i zla zhar dri med legs mthong zhing*// srid pa'i zug rngu rnam par sel ba yi// dam chos bdud rtsi'i bsil zer rab 'phro ba// rna ba'i snod du 'bab par mdzad du gsol// kun bzang rnam 'phrul mchod rdzas rgya mtsho'i sprin// kun nas bkod legs yid 'ong bkram pa yis// kun du nam mkha' khyab par blos sprul te// kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs 'khor bcas rtag tu mchod// tshul dang tshul min bdag gis ma 'tshal zhing*// las dang nyon mongs tshang tshing gis gzings pas// lus dang ngag dang yid kyis bsags pa'i sdig

/rgyal dang rgyal sras rnams kyi spyan sngar bshags// dus gsum phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad na// khams gsum gtogs pa'i skye bo ma lus dang*// lam gsum mthar phyin 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams kyi// sgo gsum dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam par gzhig pa'i phyir// theg mchog chos kyi 'khor lo bskor slad du// 'jam dbyangs rgyal ba'i 'khor gyis yongs bskor ba'i// dkyil 'khor kun tu bzhugs te bskul bar bgyi// nyid kyi nges pa'i sku ni rtag bzhugs kyang*// ma nges gdul bya bsod nams mi ldan pas// nges pa'i dbyings su zhi bar mthong rnams la// nges par rtag tu khyod sku snang bar mdzod// 'gro kun rnam grol mchog la dgod bya'i phyir// blo mchog 'jam mgon rjes su bdag zhugs nas// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// byang chub spyod mchog rgya chen spyad par bgyi// yon tan rgya mtsho mgon po 'jam dbyangs la// bstod dbyangs rgya mtshos gus pas mchod pa dang*// kun mkhyen rgya mtsho'i spyod pa legs spyad pas// dge ba rgya mtsho bdag gis gang bskrun dang*// dus rnams rgya mtshor skye bo thams cad dang*// 'phags pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis legs bsags pa'i// bsod nams rgya mtsho ji snyed yod pa kun// lhag bsam rgya mtshos gcig tu bsdoms byas nas// sems can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams ji snyed kyi// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho rnam par byang gyur nas// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho rdzogs nas rgyal ba yi// ye shes rgya mtshor myur du 'jug gyur cig /bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du// rigs gzugs dpal 'byor dbang phyug phun tshogs shing*// tshe ring nad med blo gros mchog gyur nas// sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan pa 'dzin gyur cig /bdud kyi stobs dang mu stegs gzhung lugs dang*// chos ltar bcos pa'i mun sprul thams cad dang*// gzhan yang 'gro ba'i nye bar 'tshe ba kun// bdag gi stobs kyis rtsad nas 'joms gyur cig

/skye dgu rnams kyi srid pa'i bde legs dang*// rnam par grol ba'i dpal 'byor gang yin pa// de kun 'bad pa med par bdag las ni// rang dbang nyid du ci bder 'byung gyur cig /'jam pa'i dpal gyi rnam 'phrul ji snyed pa// de snyed skad cig re la'ang bdag gis ni// ba spu'i bu ga re rer sprul nas kyang*// nam mkha'i mthas gtugs 'gro ba'i don byed shog /gnas skabs su yang bstan la gang dga' zhing*// sems can rnams la byams pa'i blo dang ldan// de 'dra'i mi dbang rtag tu zhabs brtan zhing*// de yi bsam pa chos bzhin 'grub par shog /'gro kun phan tshun brtse ba'i yid ldan zhing*// chos dang zang zing dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs// e ma ngo mtshar zhes brjod gad mo'i sgras// rgyal sras rnams kyi bsam pa tshim gyur cig /de ltar brjod 'di gang gi mthus byung ba// shes bya kun mkhyen dmigs med thugs rje can// chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan bzang po'i zhabs// 'dren mchog de la slar yang phyag 'tshal lo// blo gros rgya mtsho'i gling las legs 'khrungs pa'i// snyan pa'i 'od 'phro tshig gi nor bu'i tshogs// ngag gi srad bus tshar du dngar byas nas// 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal po legs mchod do// bstod tshig 'di ni nor bu'i phreng ba yin// 'di yis gang gi mgrin par brgyan pa de'i// sems la 'jam pa'i rdo rje rjes zhugs nas// bsnyengs bral blo gros mchog dang ldan par 'gyur// tshul 'di ni shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i de kho na nyid ston pa la/ bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba'i mkhyen rab can/ 'gro ba thams cad la bu gcig pa ltar rab tu brtse ba'i thugs rje mnga' ba sa'i steng na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba'i bdag nyid chen po/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i zhabs kyi rdul gyis spyi gtsug brgyan cing legs par bshad pa rin po che'i tshogs kyis blo gros kyi lus rnam par brgyan pa/
'phags pa'i ming dang ldan pas ri bo rtse lnga de nyid du me mo sbrul gyi lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes nyi shu gcig la rdzogs par sbyar ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
